dedupeResult: The open music-submission-agent pull request and repository search contained no existing canonical match for Resurge Audio, Joshua Tree Live or Global Entry Radio by official name, domain, submission path, published contact or Groover influencer identifier before creation. Resurge Audio's form and official music mailbox were consolidated into one record. Joshua Tree Live's form and general media contacts were consolidated without treating the inconsistent .io address as verified. Global Entry Radio's official page and exact Groover route were consolidated as one external-platform opportunity.
emailVerificationLevel: music@resurgeaudio.com was verified by first-party publication, syntax, domain alignment and explicit music-submission purpose. info@resurgeaudio.com, copyright@resurgeaudio.com and media@joshuatreelive.tv are first-party general or specialist contacts and were not substituted for canonical forms. media@joshuatreelive.io remained unconfirmed and was excluded. Global Entry Radio publishes no direct submission email. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probing was performed.
formVerificationLevel: Resurge Audio exposes a first-party link-based form with mandatory rights, submission and GDPR consent. Joshua Tree Live exposes a JavaScript-dependent direct-media-upload form. Global Entry Radio exclusively links to an external Groover route that requires login and payment; the in-session campaign fields and controls were not accessed. Hidden and submit-time controls remain manual-review boundaries.
safety: Three legitimate opportunities were queued as needs_manual_review. No email was sent, no form field was filled, no file or link was uploaded, attached or shared, no login was attempted, no CAPTCHA or anti-bot control was completed or bypassed, and no purchase, payment or submission action was completed.
